caption: The drawing depicts a figure dressed as a jester or clown, standing in profile facing to the right. The jester is wearing a red and yellow hat with a yellow ball at the end, and a blue crown-like band around the base. His collar and sleeve cuffs are large and ruffled, colored yellow with blue trim. His main outfit is a blue suit with yellow wavy trim and ruffled yellow hems at the sleeves and bottom of the pants. The jester is wearing red and white horizontally striped stockings and black shoes with heels. He holds a red, round object with a textured surface in his left hand. The figure stands atop a light green rectangular pedestal labeled "SNUFF" in large brown letters on a yellow background. The background is plain, light beige or off-white. The artist's name, "DONALD STREETER," appears written in small letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Cigar Store Figure
